instruction: The file inventory_dirty.csv has columns sku,item,qty,price (14 rows). Values of price may contain '$' and thousand commas; a blank field means missing value. How many rows have a missing (empty) price? Use bash with python3 to compute it. Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
